info.desc: Mommy's Little Monster is the debut studio album by American punk rock band Social Distortion, released in 1983 through the label 13th Floor Records. It is Social Distortion's only album to feature bassist Brent Liles and drummer Derek O'Brien, both of whom were out of the band by early 1984 and would be replaced by John Maurer and Chris Reece respectively. .

podcast.body: Released in 1983, this debut album by Social Distortion is recognized as a "proto pop punk" record. It contained musical elements that would later become evident in the sounds of influential bands like Green Day and The Offspring. "In 1983, they released a debut album called Mummy's Little Monster."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
